modifiers.notes: 'All The Way' chute off the Chair 10 ridge, entered past warning signs after the first large rock group; steep narrow choke at top and bottom, can be impassable in low snow.

modifiers.notes: Named on 2022 resort map; no terrain info found.
Probably 'Boilermaker'; double-black-ish in listings but no terrain description found. No info.
Black, E-facing, avg 21 deg (ZRankings has no max pitch). No info on hazards.
Real name 'Chamoix' (Upper/Lower). Upper Chamoix ~47 deg off Cornice Express with a steep cornice entrance (easier alternate entrance); described as a rocky chute that becomes a gladed gully.
Double black off Cornice Express past 'experts only' sign; rocky, twists around trees and moguls, ~42 deg max. Sign not confirmed as a gate.
East-facing backside run. No hazard info.
Groomed black off The Reut. No hazards.
Chute in the east/Wagon Wheel side beyond Notch; trip report had to remove skis and cross ~100 ft of windswept rocks to reach it. No info on cliffs in the chute itself.
Backside; optional hike from Chair 4 to Covered Wagon Peak (not required for the run). No info.
Black, 44 deg max, E-facing, poor snow retention (ZRankings). No hazard info.
No info (avg 12 deg; short steep pitch).
Blue groomer on backside; likely 'Devil's Drop' (Lower Devil's Drop) on the map. No hazards.

Double black (aka Waterfall) in Wagon Wheel: rocky series of drops into tight canyons toward The Drain, 'Warning - Cliffs Ahead' sign; Waterfall slot ~75 ft long, barely ski-length wide, straight-line entry.
Ungroomed open east-facing face, usually uncrowded. No hazard info.
Long blue with steep entry. No hazards.
Named chute on skier's left of Wagon Wheel Bowl (Chair 10 side); no detail on rocks/cliffs. No info.
Sentinel Bowl area off Cornice Express. No info.
Long groomed blue cruiser on the backside.
Reached by a high traverse from Cornice; 41 deg max. No hazard info.
Toughest of the Thunder Saddle chutes, along the closed Cirque boundary; narrow left side, cliffs above (Second Level). Cirque is roped, Hell's itself not confirmed gated.
Ungroomed backside run. No hazard info.
No info found; possibly unofficial name (OSM ties it to the Bunny lift).
Sentinel Bowl area ('Big Jim's' has an entry crux per one report). No reliable info.
No info found; likely unofficial/abbreviated name.
Backside bowl reached by traverse west from Sunrise; leads to short steep chutes above Caples Crest. No cliff info.
Black, 38 deg max. No info.
Steep black off Cornice; smooth when groomed but bumps develop quickly.
Off-piste-ish line toward Rabbit Runs off Cornice; 35 deg max. No info on hazards.
Groomed but steep enough to grow moguls within a day; crowded.

From Chair 10, ~1/4 mi high traverse then hike/skis-off through a ~10 ft choke in The Notch (50-100 ft cliffs either side, near-vertical ~50 ft entrance), then a narrower drain; constrictions can be impassable in low snow.

modifiers.notes: Steep back-ridge run off Cornice Express; reported bumpy, steeps on looker's right.
Reached by exiting Backside through the high gully entrance to Thunder Saddle, toward Devil's Corral. No cliff info.
Sentinel Bowl area; freeride listing mentions a hike-to line above it with rock features (not this run). No info.
Double-black chute, ~46 deg max pitch per lidar (ZRankings); off the Cornice ridge. No info on cliffs/rocks or gate.
Sentinel Bowl off Cornice Express; often groomed, good snow. Advanced trees lie beyond (west of) Sentinel Bowl, not on this run. No hazard info.
'Schaffer's Chute' listed among expert runs; ~39 deg max per ZRankings. No terrain detail. No info.
No info; may be one of the Wagon Wheel 'spokes' toward The Drain.
Steepest measured run at Kirkwood (50 deg max, 30 deg avg, W-facing) per ZRankings; no description of chute/cliffs found. No info.
Groomed black beside Chair 11, steeper than neighbors.
Upper Sisters (Diagonal Chute) off Chair 10: steep, incredibly narrow, exposed rocks; The Sisters are cliff bands with chutes between them. ~44 deg max.
No info.
Named on map, 29 deg max. No info.
No info.
Largest lower-mountain gully collecting Wagon Wheel lines; narrow, well-defined, popular/crowded. Low pitch (28 deg max).
Double black under Chair 10 (skull-and-crossbones sign; rope line marks entrance); steep open face that bumps up, rocks/scree exposed when thin; Waterfall slot halfway down is optional.
Backside run with a cornice at the top that can be dropped or skirted.
Black bowl under the Cirque, 47 deg max; entered via traverse/high gully, smooth aprons below cliffs that can be avoided.
From the backside over Thunder Saddle; a tight chute leads from Thunder Saddle into Devil's Corral. Shaded, low traffic. No cliff info.
Groomed black edge along top of Short Spoke. No hazards.
Steep little bowl / long steep groomer off Cornice. No hazard info.
